e.title: Radar Flood Mapping (UN-SPIDER)
e.summary: UN-SPIDER 官方 SAR 雷达洪水制图教程（44★）：Sentinel-1 洪水淹没范围提取 Jupyter 流程
e.body: radar-based-flood-mapping（UN-SPIDER，44★）是联合国 UN-SPIDER 官方的星载 SAR（合成孔径雷达）洪水制图 notebook：基于 Sentinel-1 雷达影像的洪水淹没范围提取——云无关的洪水监测方法，配套方法说明。对 RIAA：灾害应急的遥感洪水制图标准方法——理解 '雷达看水'（SAR 对水的低后向散射）原理与 GEE/Sentinel 流程；洪水保险理赔/巨灾响应（[[lisflood]] 预报、[[databricks-flood-prediction]] 分析）的观测验证层。

e.summary_en: Official UN-SPIDER SAR radar flood-mapping tutorial (44★): Sentinel-1 inundation-extent extraction in Jupyter
e.summary_hk: UN-SPIDER 官方 SAR 雷達洪水製圖教程（44★）：Sentinel-1 洪水淹沒範圍提取 Jupyter 流程
e.body_en: radar-based-flood-mapping (UN-SPIDER, 44★) is the official UN satellite-based SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) flood-mapping notebook: inundation-extent extraction from Sentinel-1 radar imagery — a cloud-independent flood monitoring method with full methodology notes. For RIAA: the standard remote-sensing flood-mapping approach for disaster response — understanding the 'radar sees water' principle (low SAR backscatter over water) and the GEE/Sentinel workflow; the observational validation layer for flood insurance claims and catastrophe response built on [[lisflood]] forecasts and [[databricks-flood-prediction]] analytics.
e.body_hk: radar-based-flood-mapping（UN-SPIDER，44★）是聯合國 UN-SPIDER 官方的星載 SAR（合成孔徑雷達）洪水製圖 notebook：基於 Sentinel-1 雷達影像的洪水淹沒範圍提取——雲無關的洪水監測方法，配套方法說明。對 RIAA：災害應急的遙感洪水製圖標準方法——理解『雷達看水』（SAR 對水的低後向散射）原理與 GEE/Sentinel 流程；洪水保險理賠/巨災響應（[[lisflood]] 預報、[[databricks-flood-prediction]] 分析）的觀測驗證層。
